title: MoMoVL: Modality-Aware Adaptive Compression for On-Device Sparsely-Activated Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.23695v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The rise of the agentic web has been accompanied by growing demand for on-device Vision-Language Models (VLMs) that perform diverse cross-modal web tasks with enhanced privacy and reduced latency. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are widely adopted in modern VLMs for compute-efficient scalability, yet their multi-expert architecture poses deployment challenges due to substantial memory demands. Mixed-precision quantization is an effective compression technique that reduces bit-widths while adapting to the heterogeneous hardware budgets of edge devices, particularly well-suited for MoE due to its inherent structural sparsity, which causes imbalanced importance among experts. translated_title: MoMoVL：面向端侧稀疏激活视觉语言模型的模态感知自适应压缩
translated_abstract: 智能体网络的兴起伴随着对端侧视觉语言模型日益增长的需求，这类模型能够在增强隐私保护并降低延迟的前提下执行多样化的跨模态网络任务。混合专家模型因其计算高效的扩展性而在现代视觉语言模型中被广泛采用，但其多专家架构由于庞大的内存需求而带来了部署挑战。混合精度量化是一种有效的压缩技术，能够在降低位宽的同时适应边缘设备异构的硬件预算，尤其适合混合专家模型，因为其固有的结构稀疏性会导致专家之间的重要性不均衡。尽管先前的工作已将量化应用于边缘端高效的混合专家模型推理，我们指出在基于混合专家模型的视觉语言模型中，视觉token和文本token的模态特定特征会进一步影响专家量化。为解决这一问题，我们提出了MoMoVL，一种模……
tldr: 提出MoMoVL，一种面向端侧混合专家视觉语言模型的模态感知自适应压缩方法，利用视觉与文本token的模态差异优化专家的混合精度量化，实现高效且保护隐私的端侧部署。
en_tdlr: MoMoVL introduces a modality-aware adaptive compression method for on-device MoE-based vision-language models, leveraging the distinct characteristics of visual and text tokens to optimize mixed-precision expert quantization for efficient and privacy-preserving edge deployment.
